active_deliverable: Six hidden-random-orientation LER panels plus paired directed comparison and mechanism analysis, with verified report/dashboard delivery.
question: Does hiding a fresh fair pair orientation on each active edge change the U1/SU3 finite-size LER curves relative to directed errors, while SU2 remains invariant?
program_role: Controlled physical-channel intervention and practical-decoder mechanism test; not an intrinsic or asymptotic threshold determination.

hypotheses.H_orientation: Fixed charge-pair orientation supplies useful constraints for U1/SU3; random hidden orientations increase LER or change finite-size ordering.
hypotheses.H_null: Orientation randomization has little effect on these practical-decoder curves at the registered resolution.
hypotheses.H_algorithm: Ternary BP approximation/nonconvergence, rather than intrinsic recoverability, contributes to any observed degradation.
hypotheses.SU2_control: Fundamental and antifundamental are equivalent in the local SU2 fusion law: the sampled (m,R) law is unchanged. Collapse the redundant latent orientation exactly before BP to retain the same binary activity decoder and schedule.

model.activity: iid Bernoulli(p) on each physical edge for each shot
model.directed: active edge deposits anti at stored tail and fund at head
model.undirected: independent hidden fair orientation on each edge each shot, giving edge states (off,forward,reverse) probabilities (1-p,p/2,p/2); one shared orientation at both endpoints
model.rough_boundary: m and R unmeasured and marginalized
model.SU2_primary: exact orientation quotient, binary activity BP; independent hidden-channel sampling is checked to produce identical records
model.U1_SU3_primary: ternary sum-product BP, marginalize active orientations before posterior-LLR matching

matching.orientation_seed: activity_seed+10000000; separate RNG so activity/fusion stream is unchanged
matching.paired: same activity errors, binary syndromes and fusion uniforms; R changes only through the explicit orientation intervention
matching.directed_replay: recompute baseline on matched shots and require each completed aggregate to match A8 exactly; store 2x2 joint failure counts
matching.source_integrity: freeze runner and imported scientific source hashes, baseline checkpoint hashes, runtime versions; preserve completed cells atomically

scalar and new ternary batch posterior/convergence/iteration equality on both lattices and all groups
ternary factor-tree posterior versus independent enumeration
shared endpoint direction and U1 total-charge conservation in the complete latent graph
boundary likelihood constant and no decoder-visible orientation

pilot.purpose: correctness, finite numerical outputs and resource measurement; separate from production

production_budget.stop: complete registered grid; no adaptive p/size expansion. Stop dependent acquisition on nonfinite output, invalid correction, control mismatch, baseline replay mismatch or source drift.

analysis.paired_difference: hidden minus directed; save discordant counts; conservative pointwise 95% CI from two 97.5% exact binomial Clopper-Pearson intervals via union bound; not simultaneous across cells
analysis.hypothesis_test: exact paired McNemar on discordant counts, Holm correction across 400 U1/SU3 cells; SU2 structural null checked shotwise
analysis.finite_size: show four size curves per panel; descriptive size ordering and possible finite-grid crossings only; no asymptotic threshold/no-threshold claim
analysis.diagnostics: paired BP nonconvergence fractions; note finite-schedule binary vs ternary parameterization is an algorithmic limitation
analysis.interpretation: orientation-induced finite-size changes can support a practical-decoder mechanism; cannot alone prove lack/existence of intrinsic threshold or universality

presentation: One 3x2 hidden-orientation LER figure: square left, honeycomb right; U1,SU2,SU3 rows; shared x, independent y, red light-to-dark L=5,7,9,11, external legend, no p=0 marker. Keep directed combined figure for comparison. Separate convergence and paired-effect figures.

research_basis.role: Charge-conserving U1 model and local-charge side information can support a decoding transition; no inference that directed A8 has no threshold.
BP-to-matching method; algorithmic accuracy and boundary details matter, so practical finite-size curves are not Bayes limits.
SU2 fundamental pseudoreality; combined with repository fusion law motivates exact orientation-invariant control.
Existing ternary hidden-orientation model and observation semantics reused, not a new invented channel.
